description: This file defines a generic test data set class for storage testing in Orleans-based projects. It generates test data with different parameters for testing purposes, including random grain IDs and state data.

classes.name: StorageDataSetGenericHuge
classes.description: A generic class providing test data sets for storage testing, parameterized by grain key and state data types.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing a grain type string, a grain ID, and a grain state with test data, based on the test number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the range of test cases.
